module_summary: AXI-Lite N-by-M crossbar built from independent write and read crossbar children, each decoding slave addresses, arbitrating per master port round-robin and routing responses back.

anchors.name: s_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: Slave-side write addresses decoded by write crossbar to pick master.

anchors.name: s_axil_wdata
anchors.why: Slave-side write data routed to granted master.

anchors.name: s_axil_araddr
anchors.why: Slave-side read addresses decoded by read crossbar.

anchors.name: s_axil_rdata
anchors.why: Read data routed back to requesting slave port.

anchors.name: s_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave write address requests into write crossbar.

anchors.name: s_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave read address requests into read crossbar.

anchors.name: m_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: Master-side write address from arbitrated slave.

anchors.name: m_axil_wdata
anchors.why: Master-side write data from arbitrated slave.

anchors.name: m_axil_araddr
anchors.why: Master-side read address from arbitrated slave.

anchors.name: m_axil_rdata
anchors.why: Master-side read data into read crossbar.

anchors.name: m_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Master write address valid after arbitration.

anchors.name: m_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: Master read address valid after arbitration.

anchors.name: s_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid back to slave port.

anchors.name: s_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: Read response valid back to slave port.

anchors.name: m_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid from master port.

anchors.name: m_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: Read response valid from master port.

groups.name: Write crossbar
groups.description: axil_crossbar_wr decodes AW, arbitrates per master, routes W and B.

groups.name: Read crossbar
groups.description: axil_crossbar_rd decodes AR, arbitrates per master, routes R back.
